notes: Three district-level DPR 523 records the market-octavia-survey-forms/van-ness-auto-row-forms pass (2026-09-03) read but did not extract, because each names a district rather than a single numbered address: the Pine Street Auto Shops Historic District record (William Kostura, part of the Automotive Support Structures Survey), and the Hayes Valley Residential Historic District's two updates (Page & Turnbull 2008, SF Planning 2010, part of the Market & Octavia Augmentation Survey).

coverage.remaining: Nothing of these three records. The Hayes Valley district's original 372 contributors (identified in a 1997 Caltrans survey by William Kostura) are not individually listed in either update — Page & Turnbull's 2008 update says so outright ('did not uncover a list of all 372 resources') — so they are not recoverable from this document family.
coverage.note: Pine Street: 5 buildings, all extracted (construction year, architect, style, auto-related use period). Hayes Valley 523D (Jan 2008): 158 rows, all extracted (2 exact duplicate rows in the source collapsed to 1). Hayes Valley 523L (May 2010): 273 rows, all extracted, by table column position (four contributor-status columns, since 7 of the 273 rows carry a status code that doesn't match the column it's marked in).
